CVE-2023-32784.title: In KeePass 2.x before 2.54, it is possible to recover the clearte ...
CVE-2023-32784.description: In KeePass 2.x before 2.54, it is possible to recover the cleartext master password from a memory dump, even when a workspace is locked or no longer running. The memory dump can be a KeePass process dump, swap file (pagefile.sys), hibernation file (hiberfil.sys), or RAM dump of the entire system. The first character cannot be recovered. In 2.54, there is different API usage and/or random string insertion for mitigation.

CVE-2026-86776.title: KeePass versions 2.35 through 2.61.1 fail to validate KDBX header ...
CVE-2026-86776.description: KeePass versions 2.35 through 2.61.1 fail to validate KDBX header field sizes before memory allocation in the ReadHeaderField function. Attackers can craft a malicious KDBX file declaring excessive header field lengths to trigger allocation of gigabytes of memory, causing the application to consume resources and terminate.
